name: Spotter
summary: Spotter; As a bonus action, mark one enemy you can see within 120 ft. The next ally to attack that target gains +1d4 to hit. This benefit affects allies only and does not apply to your own attack unless a later feature says otherwise.  Spotter; Your mark also adds +1 damage.  Spotter; Your marked target grants +1d4 to the next two allied attacks instead of one.  Spotter; Your mark grants +1d4 to the next three allied attacks instead of two.
